Subject: Transfer: CardioNova - Implementation scope & next steps

Hi team,

Thanks for the push — quick handoff summary for CardioNova (commercial + technical highlights) so CS can pick up the baton. I'm copying the AE->CS small playbook below and attaching the latest SOW (CardioNova_SOW_v1.pdf).

Deal at a glance:
- ARR: $420k (year 1)
- Contract signed: 2027-09-10 (e-sign done)
- Go-live target: 2028-01-15 (production traffic)
- Initial scope: inference for clinical note summarization + 40k monthly embeddings for search
- Expected QPS: ~30 concurrent requests during peak (avg 120 reqs/min); bursts to 250 RPS in testing

Key commitments we promised during negotiation:
- Dedicated model pool (Redwood Dedicated) with 99.9% uptime SLA for production
- 60-day pilot in staging with full prefix caching enabled
- Data residency: US-only; onboarding will be VPC peering
- SOC2 evidence shared; customer requests a short security call next week

Technical notes (from discovery call):
- They will push batches from their ETL (Airflow) into our ingestion API every 6 hours (approx 150k records per batch).
- They plan to use our Python SDK for embedding calls; they requested a sample adapter for batch retry logic.
- Primary integration contact: Sara Patel (sara@cardionova.com). Procurement: procurement@cardionova.com (billing).
- We confirmed KMS integration for customer-managed keys is required for production.

Open items for CS & Infra:
1) Confirm CS primary owner + coverage for on-call during pilot and go-live (we discussed 24x5).
2) Validate capacity plan for peak bursts and pre-warm Dedicated pool in Dec.
3) Run security questionnaire and share SOC2 artifacts; customer will want evidence of KV cache handling and retention policy.
4) Coordinate DocuSign SOW -> once countersigned, procurement will provision test VPC creds.

Asks: please assign a primary CS and a technical lead (SE handshake) by EOD Monday (09/13). Also propose two kickoff windows next week (I included possible slots on the HubSpot meeting link below).

HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/1536
Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/Shared/CardioNova/Onboarding-Playbook

Attachment: CardioNova_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW + milestone schedule)

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin

marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0142

1) I can own the overall CS relationship (exec sponsor) but want Tessa as day-to-day lead on implementation. Tessa, are you available to be primary steward for this?

2) For the pilot (60 days staging) we need their sample dataset (PII scrubbed) + a small subset (10k records) for early perf validation. Marcus — can you confirm if Sara can share a sanitized sample by 09/20?

3) Karthik — appreciate you staying on as the SE for the prefix-caching setup and model param tuning. Two technical asks:
   - Can we get an initial throughput test plan (scripts + acceptance thresholds)?
   - Do we have a recommended pre-warm schedule for the Dedicated pool given the burst profile Marcus shared?

4) Security / procurement: we'll run the standard security questionnaire (I'll attach the intake form once I review their SOC2 packet). Does procurement@cardionova already have the SOW countersigned?

If everyone's good, I propose we schedule the internal 30-min transfer sync Monday 09/13 10:00-10:30 PT and then a joint kickoff with CardioNova the week of 09/20.

Vanessa Ortiz
